title: The roadmap build's gap check falls back to FETCH_HEAD when origin/roadmap is missing
why: build.py's Staged(merged=True) fails open when refs/remotes/origin/roadmap is missing, as in a --single-branch clone where pull --rebase works through FETCH_HEAD, so a duplicate step passes unchecked.
note: Done check: a red case first, where a clone with no origin/roadmap ref is checked through FETCH_HEAD. From #1757's findings (lane gap-check-merge-rebase) via the coordinator, 21:13 CST Nov 7. Coordinator starts a lane after #1757 lands. Filed 21:13 CST Nov 7.
